'''Walker 693''' was an [[All Terrain Defense Pod]] operated by [[Imperial combat driver]]s of the [[Imperial Army]]. During a search for the [[Spectres|insurgents]] in a town located on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]], the [[walker]] was hijacked by the rebels in their [[Action at Mustafar|attempt]] to find their [[Raid on the communications tower|captured]] leader, [[Kanan Jarrus]]. [[C1-10P]], the [[Droid|mechanic]] member of the team accessed to the walker's [[computer]] to find information, only learning that the [[Galactic Empire|Empire]] had taken down their entire data network on Lothal. As their attempt to gain information of Jarrus failed, the team called [[Hera Syndulla]] for pickup, and managed to board the ''[[Phantom]]'' just before the walker was destroyed by Imperial reinforcements.<ref name="RR" />
